purpose: explicit device service duration as an experimental parameter; no duration is verified hardware capacity

scenarios.name: historical_baseline
scenarios.source: workload-derived: (last - first arrival) / (N - 1) of the evaluated workload, i.e. its mean inter-arrival gap
scenarios.interpretation: existing historical simulation assumption; offered load N/(N-1) by construction; not hardware capacity

scenarios.name: slower_device
scenarios.source: sensitivity assumption: baseline x 1.10 (10% longer service duration)
scenarios.interpretation: modelling assumption only; not a device specification

scenarios.name: faster_device
scenarios.source: sensitivity assumption: baseline x 0.90 (10% shorter service duration)
scenarios.interpretation: modelling assumption only; not a device specification

scenarios.name: recorded_cadence_reference
scenarios.source: recorded 14-circuit cycle cadence: 4.88 s / 14 (stated as 0.3486 s)
scenarios.interpretation: a recorded logging cadence of the original experiment; NOT verified hardware capacity

timeline_semantics: fixed wall-clock horizon: slots = floor((H - start)/d) + 1 over [start, H]; H = start of the last historical slot; release times unchanged

device_time_denominators.budget: total_slots * d (production primary; differs between scenarios by < 1 slot)
device_time_denominators.busy: executed shots * d (actual device time used)

provenance.queue_and_timing: production simulator replay of the frozen workload on each scenario grid
provenance.comparison_error: drift-model-derived (model has not shown deployment-faithful forecasting skill); not measured reliability
provenance.outcomes: recorded outcomes replayed; nothing newly measured

limitations: no service duration is verified hardware capacity
0.3486 s is a recorded cadence reference
one frozen workload, deterministic replay: not a multiple-workload statistical study
recorded outcomes are replayed; this is not a QPU experiment
